selection_policy: All final capacity-boundary, L1-conflict, software-metric and Upgrade-refinement box records; one 56/64/72 B spatial cohort, one D/I pair and one inclusion pressure/control pair per ECE host; all reported L2-conflict records for Crux and Thunderbird.
scope: Curated important raw evidence; not the exhaustive authoritative raw-data handoff. Unselected attempts remain in the external archives identified elsewhere in the repository.
